fee_notes: Royalty is 5.5% of Net Royalty Sales, adjustable up to a maximum of 6.0% with 90 days' notice. A 2026 Royalty Incentive Program reduces royalty to 0% for Accounting Periods 1-6 and 2.5% for Periods 7-18 for franchisees signing Development Agreements for 3-5 stores. Brand Development Fund: currently 1% of Net Royalty Sales (can increase by 0.5% with 90 days' notice). National Advertising Fund: 4% of Net Royalty Sales. Regional Advertising Fund varies by market (0.5%–1.2% of Net Royalty Sales, or $440/period for Tampa). Total Geography Based Advertising Funds capped at 5.5% of Net Royalty Sales combined. Local Store Marketing: minimum of 7% minus Brand Development Fund, Geography Based Advertising Funds, and Ad Co-op contributions (effectively ~2% if no regional fund applies). Total marketing spend formula targets 7% of Net Royalty Sales across all tiers. Technology Fee: $27.96 per Accounting Week (~$121/month). Software Maintenance and Support Fee: $430 per Accounting Period (~13 periods/year). SMS/MMS Program Fee: $100 per Store per Accounting Period (currently optional). Transfer fee: $5,000–$10,000. Renewal fee: $6,250 or 25% of then-current standard Initial Franchise Fee, whichever is greater. Delayed Opening Fee and Development Agreement Continuation Fee: 90% of weekly average system-wide sales × 5.5%, paid weekly.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty: 5.5% of Net Royalty Sales (subject to adjustment up to a maximum of 6.0% as described in Note 3).
Royalty - Key Management Employee Program: 2.5% of Net Royalty Sales (if commission is due to an Area Representative, this will increase by an additional 2.2%).
Royalty - 2026 Royalty Incentive Program: 0% for Accounting Periods 1-6 and 2.5% for Accounting Periods 7-18 from Store opening, then reverts to then-current Royalty rate.
Brand Development Fund: Currently, 1% of Net Royalty Sales. We have the right to increase this fee by 0.5% by giving you 90 days' prior written notice.
Geography Based Advertising Funds (includes National Advertising Fund and Regional Advertising Funds): The current amount of contribution required to our National Advertising Fund is 4% of Net Royalty Sales. Your total combined contribution to a National Advertising Fund and Regional Advertising Fund will not exceed a total of 5.5% of Net Royalty Sales combined for all levels of the Geography Based Advertising Funds.
Local Store Marketing: Calculated at minimum of 7% minus the percentage contributed to the Brand Development Fund, Geography Based Advertising Funds, and any Ad Co-op.
Technology Fee: $27.96 per Accounting Week by ACH.
Software Maintenance and Support Fees: $430 Payable each Accounting Period.
SMS/MMS Program Fee: $100 per Store per Accounting Period.
